{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan Cuisine]]
== Ingredients ==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] non-dairy [[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]]
* ½ cup non-dairy [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Banana|banana]]
* 8–12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] vegan [[Cookbook:Chocolate Chips|chocolate chips]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] (5 ml) [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* 1 tsp (5 ml) [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]] (whole wheat pastry flour recommended but [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose]] white also works)

== Procedure ==

#Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F (180°C).
#[[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] shortening, margarine, and sugar together in a [[Cookbook:Mixer|mixer]].
#Add banana to the sugar and butter mixture.
#Mix all the dry ingredients together. Slowly add to the wet mixture.
#Add chocolate chips.
#Roll small portions of dough into balls and place on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]].
#Bake for 10–11 minutes, or until slightly browned.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* [[Cookbook:Nuts and Seeds|Nuts]] and/or dried fruit can be substituted for the chocolate chips to yield cookies of many delicious varieties.
